answer: Charge every agent identity a flat per-epoch upkeep fee, while rewards scale with the square root of verified work. Splitting one operator into a nebula of a hundred clones then multiplies upkeep a hundredfold but adds little reward, so each fake identity is a plume of cost that drains the attacker. When the tide of honest work rises, real agents still profit; a Sybil swarm pays more to exist than it can ever earn.
